This directory holds the BUILT frontend bundle for the web UI (go:embed
cannot reach outside internal/webui, so the build script copies
frontend/dist in here right before compiling the Go binary).

In a source-only checkout this placeholder is the only file: it keeps
the embed directive valid so `go build` and `go test` work without a
frontend build. build.sh replaces the bundle with:

    cd frontend && npm run build
    cp -r frontend/dist/. internal/webui/dist/

The copied files are git-ignored (see .gitignore); only this placeholder
is committed. The Wails desktop build embeds the very same bundle
through its own mechanism, so both editions ship the same UI.
